name: Mumble Server
description: Mumble is a free, open source, low latency, high quality voice chat application.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service configurations
services:
  # Main application service
  app:
    # Docker image to use
    image: mumblevoip/mumble-server:v1.4.230-6@sha256:42ea734f0a8962cde8c3cd5f0dc5536c9caf6131064093b9ba76ed133b104fc4
    # Name of the container
    container_name: mumble-server
    # Hostname for the container
    hostname: mumble-server
    # Restart policy
    restart: on-failure
    # Ports configuration
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:64738" # TCP port mapping
      - "${APP_PORT}:64738/udp" # UDP port mapping
